newsitem.title: UK: Dollar reaches 7-1/2 year highs above 1.85 marks.
newsitem.headline: Dollar reaches 7-1/2 year highs above 1.85 marks.

text.p: The dollar rose above 1.85 German marks in London trading for the first time since November 1989, surpassing Monday's previous peak at 1.8490, traders said.
Earlier, dollar/yen rose to an 11-week high at 119.17 after U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin reiterated late Thursday a strong dollar is in U.S. interests.
Traders are awaiting the release of the July U.S. employment report at 1230 GMT.
At 1210 GMT, the dollar was trading at 1.8513/18 marks and 118.91/01 yen.
